_doc: Side quests handed out by people on the street (not enemies). Walk up, UP / LIGHT to talk. goal.type: kill (n, optional title), smash (n crates), fetch (an item dropped ahead at item_dx). Return to the giver to get paid. 'any' is the pool every other stage draws two from.

lines: My Biscuit ran off after the bins. Little dog, big opinions.
There's a tag on the collar with my number. And my debts.

goal.label: Find Biscuit's collar down the street

dock_street.done: That's his collar! He'll find his way back. He always does. He owes me money.

lines: Union says I can't break the crates. Union didn't say YOU can't.
Smash three for me. I'll call it stress relief on the form.
dock_street.done: Beautiful. I'm putting you down as 'weather'.

lines: The Repo boys took my mattress. With me ON it.
Knock out two of them and I'll sleep on the floor happy.
dock_street.done: Ha! Floor's cold but my heart is warm. Here, my emergency coins.

lines: Somebody clamped my boss's car. My boss is the car.
There's a ticket book blowing around the lot. Get it before the wind files it.
intake_lot.done: You saved a career. Mine. Unfortunately.

lines: The Coping Imps got out of group again.
Calm four of them down. Firmly. With your hands.
intake_lot.done: Group's back on schedule. I'm writing you in as 'progress'.

lines: The thugs out here are LOUD. I have work at six.
Make five of them quiet. Permanently-ish.
any.done: Silence. Finally. I'll be up all night enjoying it.

lines: I need some 'storm damage' for a claim.
Break four things. I'll cut you in. Legally adjacent.
any.done: Act of God, signed and stamped. You're a natural disaster.

lines: Someone grabbed my wallet and dropped it running!
It's somewhere ahead. It has my whole personality in it.
any.done: My cards! My photos! My one good receipt! Take a reward, you saint.

lines: Those animals ate at my place and didn't pay.
Teach three of them what a bill feels like.
any.done: Paid in full. In bruises. Come eat, it's on the house.
